Rectangular, fringed bag, painted with red, white and black clay pigment in horizontal bands, perimeter painted with continuous band of each colour. Three rows of coix seeds (threaded on nylon) decorate upper part of bag front, with ten twisted fibre tassels attached, each decorated with coix, red seeds ('drek') and abrus seeds (?). The next band of seeds is made up of four rows, with nine attachments: each is threaded with coix seeds, red seeds, and a small length of black tubing (cassowary quills), with two white heron feathers bound to ends.  A single strand of coix seeds is stitched to perimeter. Plaited strap attached to each side of reverse of bag, which is plain.

physical.title: bag
physical.summary: Bag, plaited from vegetable fibre, painted with clay pigment and decorated with coix seeds and feathers.  Rectangular bag, with woven and painted geometric design on front (six rectangles divided into triangles painted black and white), with three rows of coix seed and white feather tassels (four pairs each).  A horizontal band of light and dark brown fibre strips (rattan?), woven diagonally, runs around the top and base of bag.  The ends of the single, plaited handle cross at the reverse of the bag, which they are attached to.  The reverse is plain.
